data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure in order (Airport tab, type and select the airport, set start and end dates, sort) and names all four parameters, but it treats the sort step as required rather than optional and doesn't spell out the individual date-picking clicks or the sort dropdown, so a build would need a little inference.
